<script>
(function () {
  var css = [
    '.grid{',
    '  display:grid !important;',
    '  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr)) !important;',
    '  gap:28px !important;',
    '  align-items:stretch !important;',
    '}',
    '.grid > .card{',
    '  width:auto !important;',
    '  max-width:none !important;',
    '  margin:0 !important;',
    '}'
  ].join('\n');

  function inject() {
    if (document.getElementById('nifty-blog-grid-fix')) return;
    var s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'nifty-blog-grid-fix';
    s.textContent = css;
    (document.head || document.documentElement).appendChild(s);
  }

  inject();
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', inject);
  window.addEventListener('load', inject);
})();
</script>

<script>
window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    var x = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
        var confirmation = document.querySelector('.forms-confirmation-container-full');
        if (
            confirmation &&
            confirmation.getClientRects().length > 0 &&
            window.getComputedStyle(confirmation).visibility !== 'hidden'
        ) {
            if (x === 0) {
                gtag('event', 'submit', {
                    event_category: 'form',
                    event_label: window.location.pathname
                });
                x = 1;
            }
            clearInterval(timer);
        }
    }, 250);

    // Track telephone link clicks
    document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(function (link) {
        var href = link.getAttribute('href') || '';
        if (href.toLowerCase().startsWith('tel:')) {
            link.addEventListener('click', function () {
                gtag('event', 'click', {
                    event_category: 'number',
                    event_label: this.getAttribute('href')
                });
            });
        }
    });
});
</script>
